ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between dominant high-intensity white/light-grey pixels (approx. 65% area) and low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels (approx. 35% area) concentrated along the trailing margins.

Multiple small dark circular mottling spots on the light interior. A prominent dark vertical linear band on the inner right lobe and a single distinct dark circular spot in the lower-mid section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge leading to pointed, slightly upturned distal tips.
